Package com.sca4d.core.spring.call

Class CallLifecycleAdvisor

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.aop.support.AbstractPointcutAdvisor
com.sca4d.core.spring.call.CallLifecycleAdvisor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, org.springframework.aop.Advisor, org.springframework.aop.PointcutAdvisor, org.springframework.core.Ordered
public class CallLifecycleAdvisor extends org.springframework.aop.support.AbstractPointcutAdvisor
按各模块注册的注解声明选择方法，建立执行范围并进入唯一 CallLifecycle。
